video_title: Caitlin Clark or Kelsey Mitchell? Cynthia Cooper's Challenge to the Fever + Her All-Star GM Draft

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the roles of Kelsey Mitchell and Caitlin Clark
quotes.excerpt: There is nothing wrong with Kelsey being your go-to player and Caitlin being your star.
quotes.quote: There is nothing wrong with Kelsey being your go-to player and Caitlin being your star. It doesn't take away from Caitlin's ability to do everything on the court.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the selection process for the WNBA All-Star Game
quotes.excerpt: The first two high vote-getters were assigned to us per the coin toss.
quotes.quote: The first two high vote-getters were assigned to us per the coin toss. And guess who won the coin toss? Don't bet against me. I was assigned the top vote-getter, and then the other one gets the first selection in the first round. So, T-Spoon got that selection, and then we just alternated with only the starters. And then I got the first pick of the second round, which were the reserves.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on Kelsey Mitchell's role as a scorer
quotes.excerpt: Although she's a defensive-minded person and player and think coach, she understood the importance of scoring.
quotes.quote: Although she's a defensive-minded person and player and think coach, she understood the importance of scoring. So she got some good scoring on her, that surprised me a little bit. I thought she was going to go for like, you know, those defensive, get stops, and I'm like, this is an All-Star game. Ain't nobody getting no stops in an All-Star game. Everybody trying to score. It's about, uh, jet them, boom, ay, run off the glass, lob.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the competitiveness of the WNBA All-Star Game
quotes.excerpt: The WNBA All-Star game is always competitive. Always, whether they're playing USA Basketball, whether they're playing each other.
quotes.quote: The WNBA All-Star game is always competitive. Always, whether they're playing USA Basketball, whether they're playing each other. The games are always, always, always competitive, and especially when it gets down to clutch time. And I have a couple clutch players on my on my roster, y'all. I thought about that, too.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the importance of talent depth in the WNBA
quotes.excerpt: I think the thing for me is how much talent is in the WNBA.
quotes.quote: I think the thing for me is how much talent is in the WNBA. And you don't realize it until you're looking at the names of the players and you're selecting your team and you know all of the rules like you go first then the first round and then I go first in the second round and so the strategy that goes with that, but it's great.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the importance of team consistency and accountability
quotes.excerpt: You have to be able to establish roles. You have to know in important moments where we're going.
quotes.quote: You have to be able to establish roles. You have to know in important moments where we're going, what we're doing, who we're going to. And that person sometimes isn't the one that shoots the ball, she just makes the play. It could be a dump off to Boston, it could be a dump off to a three-point shot for Caitlin, it could be a dump off to a three-point shot from Kelsey. But you have to know what's happening, like what are we doing.

quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the importance of knowing the pecking order
quotes.excerpt: You have to know the pecking order because every team is going to try to exploit it.

quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the importance of proper shooting form
quotes.excerpt: When you go to shoot your three-point shot, don't try to shoot it off of two feet.
quotes.quote: When you go to shoot your three-point shot, don't try to shoot it off of two feet. Go one foot, so one, two, rhythm. This is going to help your shot be consistent. So reach to shot. So you plant this one, it's already set, reach to shot. In rhythm, you got this.
